Exposure to pollutants like particulate matter (PM2.5) and nitrogen dioxide can lead to developmental delays, reduced IQ scores, and impairments in memory and learning abilities. - Emission controls on vehicles and industry are the lever that works: London's Ultra Low Emission Zone cut roadside NO2 by about 46 percent in central London by 2022.
